name: mini-jogos

scripts.check: node tools/check-layouts.mjs && node tools/check-potions.mjs && node tools/check-azulejos.mjs && node tools/check-casa.mjs && node tools/check-fornada.mjs && node tools/check-colmeia.mjs && node tools/check-letras.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build:plugins && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && sh tools/gradle.sh assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && sh tools/gradle.sh bundleRelease
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android

description: Coleção de jogos simples para telemóvel. Grátis, open source, sem anúncios.
